risk.question: I want to buy. I can lose 10%
risk.sizing: Risking $10.00 with the stop at $98.00 ($2.00 per share at the latest close) sizes the position at 5 shares ($500.00).

risk.question: I want to buy. I can lose 10%, account 50000
risk.sizing: Risking $10.00 with the stop at $98.00 ($2.00 per share at the latest close) sizes the position at 5 shares ($500.00).

risk.question: I want to buy, risk $10k
risk.sizing: Risking $10,000.00 with the stop at $98.00 ($2.00 per share at the latest close) sizes the position at 5,000 shares ($500,000.00).

risk.question: I want to buy, risk $500, actually risk $1000

risk.question: I bought 10 shares at 95, my stop is 5%
risk.sizing: Each 100 shares bought at the latest close ($100.00) would lose $200.00 if the stop at $98.00 is hit. State a risk budget (e.g. 'risk $500') to size the position.
risk.exit: Your stated stop is $5.00 and today's candidate is $98.00: textbook practice raises the stop to $98.00. If a daily close is below $98.00, the rule says exit.
